name: Kingslayers
summary:
Kingslayers is a free-to-play Roguelite featuring both turn-based and real-time strategy elements. Select your team and choose your skills, then jump into a run to see what broken builds you can create!

Once you get your bearings, you can conquer ever-increasing ascension difficulties in single-player mode or enter multiplayer and try to climb to the top of the leaderboard.

Singleplayer- Relax and Enjoy the ride

Theory craft and min-max to your hearts content in this chill mode. See how high you can go in the ascension ranks or just create some cool unique builds. How about a build where you constantly have a Dragon die to make use of its on-death true damage dealing fireball passive? Or one where each shot from the archer fires 30 arrows? There's thousands of builds waiting for you to explore.

Multiplayer- A turn based game where speed and reaction time actually matters.

The multiplayer is designed for fast-paced, chaotic action. You and your opponent will traverse an identical run and meet at different stages to showcase your builds and outwit each other. This isn't your regular turn-based strategy - speed, quick decisions, and quick reactions are going to play a major part in you climbing to the top of the rankings.
